data.value: Will the neighbors on Alder Court fill all fourteen slots of the meal train they started for the Okafor family within four days?

A meal train sign-up for the Okafor family (who just came home with newborn twins) was posted to the sixty-household neighborhood app by Fran on the evening of 2026-10-04. The sign-up has fourteen slots. As of 2026-10-05T09:00:00-04:00, eight slots have been claimed. The remaining six slots are open for any neighbor to claim. The app allows neighbors to see the sign-up and claim slots.
